description: This file defines an abstract class 'Image_Graph_Element' that represents a drawable element within an image graphing library. It includes properties for position, styling, font, and methods for setting styles, coordinates, drawing text, and rendering elements, acting as a base class for specific graphical elements.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Element
classes.description: An abstract base class for drawable elements in the Image_Graph library, handling positioning, styling, font, and rendering logic.

methods.name: setBackground
methods.description: Sets the background fill style of the element.

methods.name: showShadow
methods.description: Enables a shadow around the element with specified color and size.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the element.

methods.name: _getBackground
methods.description: Retrieves and applies the background fill style to the canvas; private method.

methods.name: setBorderStyle
methods.description: Sets the border line style for the element.

methods.name: setBorderColor
methods.description: Sets the border color of the element.

methods.name: _getBorderStyle
methods.description: Retrieves and applies the border style to the canvas; private method.

methods.name: setLineStyle
methods.description: Sets the line style of the element.

methods.name: setLineColor
methods.description: Sets the line color of the element.

methods.name: _getLineStyle
methods.description: Retrieves and applies the line style to the canvas; private method.

methods.name: setFillStyle
methods.description: Sets the fill style of the element.

methods.name: setFillColor
methods.description: Sets the fill color of the element.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Retrieves and applies the fill style to the canvas; private method.

methods.name: _getFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font options for the element, considering inheritance and defaults; private method.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the font for the element.

methods.name: setFontSize
methods.description: Sets the font size.

methods.name: setFontAngle
methods.description: Sets the font angle, including vertical orientation.

methods.name: setFontColor
methods.description: Sets the font color.

methods.name: _clip
methods.description: Enables or disables clipping to the element's boundaries; protected method.

methods.name: _setCoords
methods.description: Sets the element's coordinates; private method.

methods.name: _move
methods.description: Moves the element by specified delta values; private method.

methods.name: _setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width relative to the left boundary; private method.

methods.name: _setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height relative to the top boundary; private method.

methods.name: setPadding
methods.description: Sets padding inside the element.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the element.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the element.

methods.name: _fillLeft
methods.description: Returns the left boundary of the fill area; private method.

methods.name: _fillTop
methods.description: Returns the top boundary of the fill area; private method.

methods.name: _fillRight
methods.description: Returns the right boundary of the fill area; private method.

methods.name: _fillBottom
methods.description: Returns the bottom boundary of the fill area; private method.

methods.name: _fillWidth
methods.description: Returns the fill width of the element; private method.

methods.name: _fillHeight
methods.description: Returns the fill height of the element; private method.

methods.name: _displayShadow
methods.description: Draws a shadow around the element if enabled; private method.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes text to the canvas at specified position with alignment and font options.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Finalizes and renders the element to the canvas, including background, border, and shadow; private method.
